title: Conservative Dueling Bandits: Preference Learning under Baseline Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.36708v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contextual dueling bandits learn from pairwise comparisons, the same feedback used to fine-tune language models from human preferences. Standard algorithms explore aggressively and can show users two poor options. We study conservative contextual dueling bandits, which require that, at every round, the cumulative score of the better displayed item stay above a $(1-\alpha)$ fraction of a trusted baseline's. An item's score is its probability of beating the best available item, so the constraint depends only on utility differences and needs no absolute rewards. This also changes how safety can be certified: we show that transferring the safety test of the conservative bandit algorithm CLUCB unchanged can incur linear regret, even when the baseline's utilities are known exactly. For linear utilities, we develop MaxInP-BC, which certifies scores through utility gaps and, when it must fall back, pairs the baseline with an informative partne

translated_title: 保守对决老虎机：基线约束下的偏好学习
translated_abstract: 上下文对决老虎机通过成对比较进行学习，这与根据人类偏好微调语言模型所使用的反馈方式相同。标准算法的探索过于激进，可能会向用户展示两个都很糟糕的选项。我们研究了保守的上下文对决老虎机问题，该问题要求在每一轮中，所展示的较优项目的累计得分始终保持在可信基线得分的 (1-α) 比例之上。项目的得分定义为其击败当前最佳可用项目的概率，因此该约束仅取决于效用差异，无需绝对奖励值。这也改变了安全性的认证方式：我们证明，若原封不动地迁移保守老虎机算法 CLUCB 的安全测试，即使基线的效用完全已知，也可能产生线性遗憾。对于线性效用场景，我们开发了 MaxInP-BC 算法，该算法通过效用差距来认证得分，并在必须回退时将基线与一个信息量丰富的配对项目进行组合。
tldr: 本文提出了保守上下文对决老虎机问题及MaxInP-BC算法，通过效用差距而非绝对奖励来认证安全性，克服了标准对决老虎机探索过于激进的问题，并首次证明直接迁移CLUCB的安全测试会导致线性遗憾。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces conservative contextual dueling bandits and the MaxInP-BC algorithm, which certifies safety through utility gaps rather than absolute rewards, addressing aggressive exploration in standard dueling bandits while proving that directly transferring CLUCB's safety test can incur linear regret.
